product_overview: NAITIK.OS is a single-page, OS-style portfolio experience for Naitik Goyal that blends interactive sections, gamification, and a Gemini-powered AI chatbot. It showcases skills, projects, achievements, education, and contact options in a polished dark-theme interface with smooth navigation and lightweight persistence.
core_goals: Present Naitik Goyal’s developer profile in an immersive, recruiter-friendly format
Enable fast navigation to skills, projects, education, and contact actions from a single page
Increase engagement through gamification, unlock states, sound effects, and confetti
Provide a real AI-assisted contact experience with Gemini primary and local fallback
Track project exploration progress locally to reward completed discovery

features.name: Hero Section
features.description: Landing section that establishes the product identity, shows Naitik’s status and role, and provides primary calls to action to explore the portfolio.
user_flows: GET / with page load at window.scrollY === 0 -> Render SYSTEM STATUS: ONLINE badge, title, tagline, and CTAs -> Click EXPLORE PROJECTS -> Smooth-scroll to #projects section
GET / with page load at window.scrollY === 0 -> Render hero content and VIEW PROFILE CTA -> Click VIEW PROFILE -> Smooth-scroll to #profile section
GET / with page load -> Render animated chevron indicator -> Click chevron or scroll cue -> Move focus down the page toward the next sections
GET / with missing or delayed section rendering -> Hero still loads first -> CTAs remain visible and usable -> User can continue navigation without auto-focus issues

features.name: Floating Navigation HUD
features.description: Fixed navigation bar that provides section shortcuts, resume download, sound toggle, and mobile menu access throughout the portfolio.
user_flows: GET / -> Render floating HUD with logo, 7 section links, resume button, and sound toggle -> Click PROFILE/JOURNEY/SKILLS/PROJECTS/ACHIEVEMENTS/EDUCATION/CONTACT -> Smooth-scroll to the matching section anchors
GET / -> Click NAITIK.OS logo -> Scroll to #hero -> Resume browsing from the top of the portfolio
GET / -> Click Download Resume -> Request /Naitik_Goyal_Resume.pdf -> Receive PDF download in browser
GET / -> Click sound toggle -> Update mute state in localStorage -> Mute or unmute hover/click/unlock sounds for the session
GET / on mobile viewport -> Click hamburger icon -> Open full overlay menu -> Select a section link -> Close overlay and scroll to target section
GET / -> Click a nav item with unavailable anchor/section state -> Navigation fails gracefully without leaving the page -> User remains on the SPA and can retry

features.name: Player Profile Section
features.description: Gamified identity card presenting Naitik’s role, location, status, and quick contact actions for direct outreach or profile review.
user_flows: GET / -> Render profile card with email, LinkedIn, GitHub, and resume actions -> Click SEND MESSAGE -> Open mailto:goyalnait678@gmail.com in the user’s email client
GET / -> Render quick-action buttons -> Click CONNECT -> Open https://linkedin.com/in/naitik-goyal-843504399 in a new tab
GET / -> Render quick-action buttons -> Click GITHUB -> Open https://github.com/Naitg94 in a new tab
GET / -> Render quick-action buttons -> Click DOWNLOAD RESUME -> Request /Naitik_Goyal_Resume.pdf -> Download the resume PDF
GET / -> Click a contact action while browser blocks popups or mailto handling -> Show no disruptive crash -> Keep the user on the portfolio and allow retrying the action

features.name: Developer Journey
features.description: Timeline-style progression that communicates Naitik’s growth across five skill levels, from web development foundations to building intelligent systems.
user_flows: GET / -> Render the 5-level journey timeline -> Review milestones from Web Development to current Intelligent Systems focus -> Scroll through the progression cards without requiring interaction
GET / -> Journey section fails to fully animate or load -> Show the timeline structure in a readable fallback state -> Preserve the section content so the user can still understand progression
GET / -> Navigate from HUD to #journey -> Smooth-scroll to the journey section -> View the current level emphasis and status

features.name: Skill Universe
features.description: Interactive grid of skill nodes grouped into core categories with status labels that communicate current proficiency and learning stage.
user_flows: GET / -> Render skill categories: Programming, Frontend, Backend/Systems, AI & Intelligent Systems, Tools & Platforms -> Inspect node labels such as BUILDING WITH, WORKING WITH, LEARNING, and EXPLORING -> Continue scrolling or clicking through the grid
GET / -> Navigate to #skills -> Hover or select a skill node -> Display the relevant skill cluster details in the interactive universe
GET / -> Skill assets or interactions fail to resolve -> Keep category labels and node grid visible -> User can still read the skill distribution without a hard failure

features.name: Project Database
features.description: Interactive two-panel project console that lets users inspect four featured projects, launch live demos, and track exploration progress with localStorage-backed gamification.
user_flows: GET / -> Render PROJECT 01 to PROJECT 04 index cards in the left panel -> Select PROJECT 01 (REVORA) -> Display the full REVORA brief in the detail panel -> Click VIEW LIVE PROJECT -> Open https://revora-fawn.vercel.app/ in a new tab
GET / -> Render project index and detail panels -> Select PROJECT 02 (TREE PLANTATION) -> Display the project brief -> Click LAUNCH PROJECT -> Open https://tree-plantation-xi.vercel.app/ in a new tab
GET / -> Render project console -> Select PROJECT 03 (EXPENSE TRACKER) -> Display the brief -> Click EXPLORE APPLICATION -> Open https://naitg94.github.io/Expense-Tracker/ in a new tab
GET / -> Render project console -> Select PROJECT 04 (GOYAL TRADERS) -> Display the brief -> Click VISIT PROJECT -> Open https://naitg94.github.io/Goyal-Traders-2/ in a new tab
GET / -> Select a project card that has not yet been explored -> Mark the project as visited in localStorage -> Update the counter to show X/4 PROJECTS EXPLORED
GET / -> Explore all 4 projects over multiple visits -> localStorage records all project IDs -> Reveal the [PROJECT ARCHIVIST] badge -> Play unlock sound effect

GET / -> Click a project launch action when the destination is unavailable -> Open action fails gracefully in a new tab or is blocked by the browser -> The project console remains usable and exploration state is preserved

features.name: Achievement Vault
features.description: Collectible achievement area containing three category-based cards that reward clicks with celebratory effects and sound feedback.
user_flows: GET / -> Render CERTIFICATION, EVENT EXPERIENCE, and PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE achievement cards -> Click any card -> Trigger confetti burst and unlock sound -> Keep the user on the page
GET / -> Render category badges with cyan, blue, and violet styling -> Inspect the achievement categories -> Understand the breadth of experience at a glance
GET / -> Click an achievement card while sounds are muted -> Trigger confetti only or reduced feedback -> Respect the current mute state without breaking interaction
GET / -> Attempt to interact before assets load -> Show the cards with safe default styles -> Allow the user to retry clicking without losing page state

features.name: Education Node
features.description: Education card presenting Naitik’s B.Tech CSE (AI/ML) details, institution, duration, semester, and focus areas without showing CGPA.
user_flows: GET / -> Render education node with institution, duration, semester, and focus areas -> User reviews academic background -> Continue to contact or other sections
GET / -> Education data is missing or delayed -> Show the card shell and available metadata -> Keep the section readable without displaying any CGPA
GET / -> Navigate to #education from the HUD -> Smooth-scroll to the education section -> Read the program overview and specialization

features.name: Contact Terminal & AI Chatbot
features.description: Contact area that combines direct outreach options with a multi-turn AI chatbot powered by Gemini, backed by a local fallback mode when needed.
user_flows: GET / -> Render contact info and chatbot with AI CONNECTED status -> Type a message and submit -> POST /api/chat with the user prompt and conversation context -> Receive 200 with Gemini-generated reply -> Display response and optional action buttons

GET / -> Render suggestion chips such as 'Who is Naitik?' and 'Show me his projects' -> Click a suggestion chip -> Auto-fill and submit the prompt -> POST /api/chat -> Receive a contextual answer with buttons like OPEN REVORA or SEND EMAIL
GET / -> Send a valid chat message -> Receive response with OPEN REVORA action -> Click OPEN REVORA -> Open https://revora-fawn.vercel.app/ in a new tab
GET / -> Send a valid chat message -> Receive response with SEND EMAIL action -> Click SEND EMAIL -> Open mailto:goyalnait678@gmail.com in the email client
GET / -> Send a valid chat message -> Receive response with DOWNLOAD RESUME action -> Click DOWNLOAD RESUME -> Request /Naitik_Goyal_Resume.pdf -> Download the resume PDF
POST /api/chat with an empty message or invalid payload -> Receive 400 error from the chat endpoint -> Show a safe error state in the terminal and preserve the conversation history

POST /api/chat when Gemini API is unavailable or server-side key is missing -> Fallback to local AI engine response -> Display LOCAL MODE status badge and continue the conversation without interruption
GET / -> Click LinkedIn contact action from the left panel -> Open https://linkedin.com/in/naitik-goyal-843504399 in a new tab -> Return to the chat or contact panel

persistence: localStorage (project exploration tracking, sound mute state)
audio: Custom soundFx utility (hover, click, unlock events)
